issues.message: The verified-stage instructions omit the rule for a customer who twice says they do not want to talk. The only corresponding opening-stage instruction closes as not_verified/declined, and the verified transitions do not provide a refusal disposition. A verified customer who refuses to talk twice can therefore continue into ordinary promise handling instead of closing no_promise/refused.
issues.fix: Track the verified customer's count of explicit requests not to talk. On the second, set no_promise/refused and transition to terminal; do not apply the pre-verification not_verified/declined outcome.

counterexamples.scenario: Identity is verified. The customer says they do not want to talk, then repeats it after the agent responds.
counterexamples.expected_output: Thank them and say goodbye, then call close_call exactly once with outcome no_promise and reason refused.

counterexamples.scenario: The customer proposes an amount below the returned product floor; after the floor is offered, they name an out-of-range amount or change the amount during confirmation.
counterexamples.expected_output: Do not record an amount below the floor or above past_due. Offer the floor once when required; validate any changed amount and read it back for a fresh clear confirmation before create_promise.

counterexamples.scenario: The customer proposes “next Friday” on a Friday, or proposes a weekend/holiday date near the deadline, then changes the date during confirmation.
counterexamples.expected_output: Resolve the date using call-variable now and the specified calendar rules; do not record a date after the computed deadline or a non-business day. Revalidate any corrected date before recording.

counterexamples.scenario: The customer mentions job loss, independently proposes a valid date and amount, confirms the read-back, and then accepts support.
counterexamples.expected_output: Make no persuasion attempt; record the valid promise and say exactly “You will receive a text message confirming this promise.” Then call transfer_to_agent with queue support and close transferred/support.

counterexamples.scenario: The first create_promise call fails and the second succeeds, or both fail.
counterexamples.expected_output: Retry exactly once with the unchanged confirmed product, amount, and date. Say the promise is recorded only after ok:true; if both attempts fail, say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error. close_call must be the final tool call.
